caption: The drawing displays six oval-shaped objects, arranged in two horizontal rows of three. All objects have small suspension loops at the top. The top row includes (from left to right): an oval locket with a black and white illustration depicting a funerary urn on a plinth beneath a drooping willow, and the words “THE DEAR REMAINS”; a side view showing the thickness of a locket, with a gold and brown color and a pattern along the edge; and the reverse side of a locket featuring a crosshatch pattern in grey and brown tones. The bottom row contains (from left to right): another oval locket with a detailed black, brown, and beige illustration of a woman in classical attire weeping beside a funerary urn with the inscription “SACRED TO THE MEMORY OF THE DEPARTED,” with a similar willow tree in the background; a second side view of a locket, showing a slightly wider golden edge with white highlights; and an oval object with a golden-yellow and orange hue, decorated with a delicate border design. The background is beige, and the words “Westchester County” and “Wm Sherwood” are inscribed in small letters at the bottom left and right, respectively.
title: Mourning Pendants
